newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka puts final date for Airlanka bids.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka puts final date for Airlanka bids.

text.p: Sri Lanka on Monday invited final bids for a 40 percent stake in and management of the national carrier Airlanka.
The Public Enterprises Reform Commission (PERC) said in a statement that the deadline for submitting bids was May 23.
Bidding documents sent to interested firms consisted of bidding guidelines and other details like draft transfer and shareholders' agreements, it said.
A PERC spokeswoman declined to say how many companies had shown an interest in taking over the national carrier but said the bids would be confined to companies with airline experience.
Airlanka is to be privatised under a government programme to restructure or privatise loss-making and poorly run public enterprises.
